mapper.select: select 1 from sys_user where user_id=#{accountId} and status='0' and del_flag='0' for update
select request_hash as requestHash,resource_id as resourceId from p_api_idempotency where account_id=#{accountId} and scope=#{scope} and request_id=#{key} for update
mapper.sql: id as endpointId,account_id as accountId,name,url,status,events,timeout_ms as timeoutMs, max_attempts as maxAttempts,revision,sign_secret_id as secretId,created_at as createdAt,updated_at as updatedAt
mapper.select: select from p_webhook_endpoint where account_id=#{accountId} and status!='DELETED' order by created_at desc,id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from p_webhook_endpoint where account_id=#{accountId} and status!='DELETED'
select from p_webhook_endpoint where account_id=#{accountId} and id=#{endpointId} and status!='DELETED'
select from p_webhook_endpoint where account_id=#{accountId} and id=#{endpointId} and status!='DELETED' for update
select id,ciphertext,nonce,auth_tag,key_version,algorithm,status from p_secret where id=#{secretId} and account_id=#{accountId} and purpose='WEBHOOK_SIGN'
mapper.update: update p_secret set status='DISABLED',revision=revision+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{secretId} and account_id=#{accountId} and purpose='WEBHOOK_SIGN' and status='ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: insert into p_webhook_endpoint (id,created_at,updated_at,account_id,name,url,sign_secret_id,signature_version,status,events,timeout_ms,max_attempts,revision) values (#{id},utc_timestamp(3),utc_timestamp(3),#{accountId},#{input.name},#{input.url},#{secretId},'v1','ACTIVE', cast(#{events} as json),#{input.timeoutMs},#{input.maxAttempts},1)
mapper.update: update p_webhook_endpoint set sign_secret_id=#{secretId},revision=revision+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where account_id=#{accountId} and id=#{endpointId} and sign_secret_id=#{oldSecretId} and revision=#{revision} and status!='DELETED'
update p_webhook_endpoint set status=#{status},revision=revision+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where account_id=#{accountId} and id=#{endpointId} and revision=#{revision} and status!='DELETED'
mapper.select: select t.id as taskId,t.account_id as accountId,t.avatar_id as avatarId, t.avatar_version_id as versionId,t.webhook_endpoint_id as endpointId,t.status,t.error_code as errorCode, t.reservation_no as executionNo,t.finished_at as finishedAt from p_generation_task t where t.account_id=#{accountId} and t.id=#{taskId}
mapper.sql: select uuid_short(),utc_timestamp(3),utc_timestamp(3),t.account_id, concat('evt_',t.id,'_',t.reservation_no,'_',left(t.status,1)),'WEBHOOK_AVATAR_TERMINAL','GENERATION_TASK', cast(t.id as char),1,concat('evt_',t.id,'_',t.reservation_no,'_',left(t.status,1)), json_object('taskId',cast(t.id as char),'avatarId',cast(t.avatar_id as char), 'versionId',cast(t.avatar_version_id as char),'endpointId',cast(t.webhook_endpoint_id as char), 'taskStatus',t.status,'errorCode',t.error_code,'executionNo',t.reservation_no, 'finishedAt',date_format(t.finished_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ')), 'PENDING',0,utc_timestamp(3) from p_generation_task t where t.webhook_endpoint_id is not null and t.status in ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED')
mapper.insert: insert ignore into p_outbox (id,created_at,updated_at,account_id,event_id,event_type,aggregate_type,aggregate_id,schema_version,trace_id,payload,status,attempt_count,next_run_at) and not exists (select 1 from p_outbox o where o.event_id=concat('evt_',t.id,'_',t.reservation_no,'_',left(t.status,1)))
mapper.select: select id,account_id as accountId,event_id as eventId,payload from p_outbox where event_type='WEBHOOK_AVATAR_TERMINAL' and status='PENDING' order by id limit 1 for update skip locked
mapper.insert: insert ignore into p_webhook_delivery (id,created_at,updated_at,account_id,endpoint_id,event_id,task_id,avatar_id,event_type,payload,endpoint_snapshot,status,attempt_count,next_attempt_at,expires_at) values (#{id},utc_timestamp(3),utc_timestamp(3),#{event.accountId},#{event.endpointId},#{event.eventId}, #{event.taskId},#{event.avatarId},#{event.eventType},cast(#{payload} as json),cast(#{snapshot} as json), 'PENDING',0,utc_timestamp(3),null)
mapper.update: update p_outbox set status='SENT',published_at=utc_timestamp(3),updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and status='PENDING' and event_type='WEBHOOK_AVATAR_TERMINAL'
mapper.select: select id,account_id as accountId,endpoint_id as endpointId,event_id as eventId, payload,attempt_count as attemptCount,status from p_webhook_delivery where (status='PENDING' and next_attempt_at <= utc_timestamp(3)) or (status='SENDING' and lease_expires_at <= utc_timestamp(3)) order by created_at,id limit 1 for update skip locked
mapper.update: update p_webhook_delivery set status=#{status},last_error_code=#{errorCode}, lease_owner=null,lease_expires_at=null,next_attempt_at=null,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and status in ('PENDING','SENDING')

update p_webhook_delivery set status='SENDING',lease_owner=#{owner}, lease_expires_at=date_add(utc_timestamp(3),interval 60 second),attempt_count=attempt_count+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and ((status='PENDING' and next_attempt_at <= utc_timestamp(3)) or (status='SENDING' and lease_expires_at <= utc_timestamp(3)))

update p_webhook_attempt set finished_at=utc_timestamp(3),http_status=#{httpStatus}, error_code=#{errorCode},latency_ms=#{latencyMs},updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where delivery_id=#{deliveryId} and attempt_no=#{attemptNo} and finished_at is null

update p_webhook_delivery set status=#{status},last_http_status=#{httpStatus}, last_error_code=#{errorCode},next_attempt_at=case when #{status}='PENDING' then date_add(utc_timestamp(3),interval #{delaySeconds} second) else null end, delivered_at=case when #{status}='DELIVERED' then utc_timestamp(3) else delivered_at end, lease_owner=null,lease_expires_at=null,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and status='SENDING' and lease_owner=#{owner} and lease_expires_at > utc_timestamp(3)
mapper.select: select id from p_webhook_delivery where account_id=#{accountId} and id=#{deliveryId}
